newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sept trade deficit seen at $400 mln-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sept trade deficit seen at $400 mln-paper.

text.p: Brazil is likely to show a $400 million trade deficit in September, O Estado de Sao Paulo daily said on Wednesday.
The estimates are based on the amount of exports for the first 20 days of the month, which totalled $2.971 billion, it said.
In the third week of September, daily average exports were $211.2 million. If Brazil continued exporting at the same pace, total sales would reach up to $4.2 billion, the newspaper said.
So far this year, Brazil's trade balance has posted a deficit of $937 million, it added.
